issues: Flat light-grey background with a 128px bold title: empty frame, no layout skeleton, no frame reads as a designed poster
The 0.3x label lands at ~38px with no visual anchor and no hierarchy with the content below
Content area is a 21–34px list card: too small to read, a generic dashboard rather than a shot-designed frame
The two variants are joined by a 4f white flash; the sections ignore each other and the top-left label never makes room
Selection uses system blue, unrelated to the rest of the palette, like a UI screenshot rather than a design language
changes: Switched to the paper look (warm paper, ink, vermilion) with a 120px grid margin, hairlines and mono header/footer: a Swiss-grid editorial page for a fictional notes app, Margin

Hero title is now a 220px / 850-weight single-word poster ('Capture.', 'Select.') with a vermilion period as the anchor; letters rise from a mask line, eyebrow tracking tightens, 20f hold with a 1.5% slow push
Demotion is a single 26f asymmetric in-out (decisive start, very soft landing) to 0.22 (~48px label) with velocity-based directional blur; a '01 /' prefix wipes in as it lands

Content rebuilt at large sizes: 60px lead + three clip cards (article / dark quote card / voice waveform); B is 58px body copy with an in-sentence vermilion selection, a connector line and a margin answer card, revealed with dense-then-sparse clipped stagger
No white flash: one shared stage, A's content exits upward with ease-in, A's label moves up a row and greys out as the previous section, and B's label lands in the same slot
Duration 196f to 246f; each variant gets a 20f+ settle hold and the final frame is a complete editorial poster
